what_i_see: Slightly curved, two-knot elongated feature ~2.5" long just SW of centre, yellow-white, faint tail running north to a compact red point source (2.3" N). It sits in a chain between a disturbed galaxy 4" N and a galaxy 6" S, together tracing a larger arc concave to the east.
most_likely: A tidal bridge or debris between the two neighbouring galaxies, or a clumpy edge-on background galaxy projected into the chain.
against_it: Lens reading weak: no plausible deflector on the concave side and the arc colour matches the neighbours.
decisive_test: Spectra of arc and both neighbours: shared redshift means tidal bridge; a higher-redshift arc with a deflector would mean lensing.
catalogue_notes: Legacy DR8 photo-z: EXP z=0.96+/-0.14 at 1.6" (on arc); PSF pstar 0.92 at 2.3" (red point, zphot 4.1 junk). Nearest NED WISE source ~11". No SIMBAD/Gaia within 30". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
